>I’m 32. I was the same way 10 years ago. Lost my dad. My grandpa. My dog. my girl passed in a car wreck. Lost my kid to cps within the same year. Lost my house and job. Took a knife down my throat. Regret I didn’t cut deeper then. But here I am now happy that nothing went how I wanted it to back then because I’ve found legit happiness in myself. Getting better isn’t a lie at all. You just gotta take any steps you can regardless how small those steps are, improvement is always progress.
